description: This source file implements a web configuration framework with message queue handling, subdocument registration, version management, and request processing for a web configuration system. It includes functions for registering subdocs, handling blob requests, managing queues, and communicating via message queues, with support for multi-component scenarios.

methods.name: display_subDocs
methods.description: Debugging thread function that logs registered subdocs and queue states periodically.

methods.name: register_sub_docs
methods.description: Registers supported subdocuments, initializes queues, and starts debugging and reset threads.

methods.name: notifyVersion_to_Webconfig
methods.description: Notifies webconfig client of subdoc version updates or crash events.

methods.name: check_component_crash
methods.description: Checks if a component crashed based on presence of init file and notifies webconfig accordingly.

methods.name: defFunc_calculateTimeout
methods.description: Default function to calculate timeout based on number of entries.

methods.name: send_NACK
methods.description: Sends a NACK message indicating blob execution failure.

methods.name: send_ACK
methods.description: Sends an ACK message indicating blob execution success or timeout.

methods.name: updateVersionAndState
methods.description: Updates subdoc version and state after blob execution.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to subdoc info for version update.

methods.name: isQueueFull
methods.description: Checks if the request queue is full.

methods.name: addEntryToQueue
methods.description: Adds a new request entry to the queue.

methods.name: isQueueEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the request queue is empty.

methods.name: removeEntryfromRearEnd
methods.description: Removes the most recent entry from the rear of the queue, used on send failure.

methods.name: removeEntryFromQueue
methods.description: Removes the front entry from the queue after processing.

methods.name: execute_request
methods.description: Thread function to execute blob request with timeout handling.

methods.name: messageQueueProcessing
methods.description: Main thread function to process incoming messages from message queue and handle blob execution.

methods.name: initMessageQueue
methods.description: Initializes message queue and starts message processing thread.

methods.name: checkIfVersionExecInQueue
methods.description: Checks if a version is already in queue, returns queue index if so.

methods.name: checkNewVersionUpdateRequired
methods.description: Determines if a new version needs to be processed or if request is already in queue.

methods.name: getPendingQueueTimeout
methods.description: Calculates total timeout for pending requests in queue for a given transaction ID.

methods.name: PushBlobRequest
methods.description: Main function to handle incoming blob requests, decide on queueing, and send acknowledgments.

methods.name: resetSubdocVersion
methods.description: Resets the version of a specified subdocument to zero.
